paragraphs.source_en: “When women wear their hair in a topknot, this part gets pulled tight, so anyone’s bound to go bald there!” She said this in her own defense.

paragraphs.source_en: “To say a woman of twenty might still grow taller, you really do make a fool of people.” The master’s wife threw down the sleeveless jacket and twisted round toward him. Her manner said that, depending on his answer, she had no intention of letting the matter rest.

paragraphs.source_zh: “都二十岁了，还会长个儿，真拿人开心。”主人的妻子扔下坎肩儿，朝主人扭过身子。那架势就好像看主人如何回答，大有不依不饶的架势。

paragraphs.source_en: “Even if you were twenty, there is no law saying you absolutely could not grow. I thought that if I fed you nourishing food after you came as my wife, there might still be some hope of your growing a little.” With a perfectly serious face, the master set forth this curious piece of reasoning. Just then the bell at the front door rang vigorously, and at the same time a loud voice called, “Anyone home?” It seemed that Mr. Suzuki, using the weeds on the roof as his guide, had finally found his way to Kushami’s hidden den.

paragraphs.source_zh: “你那时虽是二十岁，也不见得就不长个儿，我想你嫁过来后多给你吃点有营养的东西，还有希望再长点个儿嘛。”主人脸上带着一本正经的表情，讲出很怪的理由。就在这时，门口的电铃很有劲地响起来，同时传来很大的声音：“请问，有人吗？”看来，铃木君以房顶的乱草为目标总算找到苦沙弥的卧龙窟来了。

paragraphs.source_en: The master’s wife put the quarrel aside for another day, hastily gathered up the sleeveless jacket and sewing box, and fled into the living room. The master rolled up the gray blanket and threw it into the study. Before long, after looking at the calling card the maid brought in, the master showed a slightly surprised expression and then said, “Show him in here.” So saying, he went into the privy with the card still clenched in his hand. Why he suddenly went into the privy is something I cannot make out at all. And why he took Tojuro Suzuki’s calling card into the privy with him is still harder for me to explain. At any rate, the unfortunate one was Mr. Calling Card, ordered to accompany him into that foul-smelling place.
